requirements.risk: Frontend may present forged/malformed or failed session state as authenticated.

scenarios.given: The backend returns an authenticated string user ID
scenarios.then: Use same-origin credentials and no-store; retain only the string principal ID, never the CSRF token
tests: workspace.test.mjs#session reads only the same-origin authenticated session with no-store

scenarios.then: 401 stays anonymous; every invalid or failed response stays unavailable without leaking server details
tests: workspace.test.mjs#malformed identity, server failures and network errors never claim authentication

requirements.risk: The baseline could replace persistent panels, confuse users with invented finance data, or share theme preference across identities.

scenarios.given: An anonymous session in the approved A plus dark-mode shell
scenarios.when: Render the real React workspace to markup
scenarios.then: Keep both named panels, Fancy's labelled separator at28percent, System/Light/Dark controls and separate preference keys
tests: workspace.test.mjs#workspace keeps two named panels and the published accessible splitter
workspace.test.mjs#workspace exposes System, Light and Dark choices without fake finance or provider controls
workspace.test.mjs#theme storage is separate for each authenticated user and the signed-out workspace

scenarios.then: Show Workspace unavailable and a recovery action with no private diagnostic/token content
tests: workspace.test.mjs#failed session checks show recovery without leaking response details or showing data

requirements.risk: Node test execution could run without reviewed acceptance or silently retain changed/skipped/unmapped coverage.

scenarios.given: Independent reviewed positive and negative Node fixtures
tests: alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment accepts independent reviewed positive and negative fixtures

scenarios.given: Skipped tests, empty coverage, weakened source or a new unmapped test
scenarios.then: Reject each invalid state with a specific skip/requirements/source-changed/unmapped diagnostic
tests: alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment rejects missing coverage and skipped tests
alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment rejects weakened tests and unrelated mappings after review

requirements.risk: Browser update tracking could invent an update on errors, expose private responses, share seen cursors, or omit a discoverable updates control.

scenarios.given: A valid public version, the installed release groups and two separate principals
scenarios.when: Check a build and render the update surface
scenarios.then: Use bounded same-origin uncached checks; show the installed release label, build and named What's new action; Fancy selects only unseen groups with separate cosmetic keys
tests: updates.test.mjs#version checks fetch the same-origin uncached build with bounded lifetime and no redirects
updates.test.mjs#release notes describe the installed build and Fancy selects only unseen release groups per account
updates.test.mjs#the update surface always exposes the installed build and a named whats-new button without a false update alert

scenarios.given: Failed transport, non-JSON, 503 or invalid build IDs
scenarios.then: Reject with only Build check unavailable so the package does not announce an invented update
tests: updates.test.mjs#failed or malformed version responses reject with a generic message instead of signalling an update

requirements.risk: A constant or inconsistent version could hide backend/frontend changes, include runtime files, or mislabel release notes.

scenarios.given: A fixture with backend, frontend, release notes and an excluded runtime file
scenarios.when: Generate identities across repeated inputs and independent source changes
scenarios.then: Produce stable64hex IDs across repeated builds/newlines/runtime changes, but a different ID for each backend/frontend/notes change
tests: build-info.test.mjs#build identity is stable across repeated builds and checkout newlines but changes with backend frontend or notes

scenarios.given: Empty, duplicate, malformed or non-text release cards
scenarios.then: Refuse each invalid release with Invalid release metadata
tests: build-info.test.mjs#empty duplicate or malformed release metadata stops the build instead of generating a misleading release
